provenance: Locally authored synthetic hands; no human game records. Complete physical walls are constructed by wall_for_hands and checked before play.

double_ron.expected: Seat 1: 4 han 40 fu = 8000; seat 2: 2 han 40 fu = 2600. Nearest winner alone receives honba and deposits.

triple_ron.expected: Triple ron aborts without score transfer; same dealer, honba increments, deposits carry.

call_priority.expected: Ron preempts pon and chi; after declining ron, pon preempts chi.

ankan.expected: Closed kan exposes its dora before the replacement draw; four tiles enter a closed meld.

kakan.expected: Pon followed by drawing the fourth copy permits added kan; dora is delayed until discard or a following replacement draw.

riichi_ankan_allowed.expected: After riichi discarding green, drawing fourth 1m preserves the white-dragon wait and permits ankan.

riichi_ankan_forbidden.expected: After riichi, ankan of 8s would remove the 7s wait from the 7s/9s wait set, so is illegal.

temporary_furiten.expected: Declining first white-dragon ron blocks the next ron before own turn, then own draw/discard clears temporary furiten.

discard_furiten.expected: Discarding own winning tile blocks subsequent ron, while later tsumo remains legal.

dealer_tenhou.expected: Dealer first-draw win is tenhou: 16000 from each opponent before honba; dealer continues except applicable match-end conditions.

kyuushu.expected: Nine-or-more distinct terminal/honor kinds on uninterrupted first turn permits abortive draw and continuation.

riichi_discard_ron.expected: A ron on the riichi declaration discard prevents its 1000-point deposit from being accepted.

riichi_furiten.expected: After accepted riichi, declining a winning discard causes furiten that survives the next own draw/discard.

exhaustive_dealer_tenpai.expected: All seats always discard their drawn tile and decline calls/wins. Only dealer starts and remains tenpai: +3000/-1000/-1000/-1000, repeat and increment honba.

exhaustive_dealer_noten.expected: Only next seat is tenpai at exhaustive draw. Dealer advances, honba increments, and match-end/extension conditions are evaluated.
